exposure: AFLP patients with and without negative fetal outcomes
AFLP patients with postpartum hemorrhage exceeding 500 ml who did and did not undergo intrauterine balloon tamponade
cohort: 55 mothers with AFLP and 220 matched mothers without AFLP at a single center from January 2008 to June 2018
finding: Mothers with AFLP experienced significantly higher rates of adverse maternal and fetal outcomes, including mortality, compared to mothers without AFLP.
mod_finding: 78.8% of AFLP patients underwent cesarean section, with 53.6% of those receiving preventive plasma transfusion before surgery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at AFLP diagnosis: 35.25 ± 5.80 weeks
